neighbours.label: a stated cost or drawback of a course of action (adds to the cost, would be slow and a waste, could cause serious problems), as against the same setup with a benefit stated instead
fire: Moving the servers abroad would raise latency, which adds to the overall cost of the service.
# sorting the whole list every time would be slow and a waste of CPU

# polling the API every second would be slow and a waste of bandwidth

# sorting the whole list every time keeps the code short and clear
Adding a second inspection step catches more faults, which keeps customers happy.
Rebuilding the index nightly keeps search results fresh and accurate.
Keeping two copies of every file protects us if one disk fails.
# polling the API every second keeps the dashboard up to date
Training each model from scratch gives a clean baseline for comparison.
Printing every report on paper makes it easy to read in meetings.
